Name: FMScan - Dominator fire-mode scan
Description: READ-ONLY diagnostic. Value-scans memory for the Dominator's fire-mode record (mode array [single, burst, none] plus TertiaryFireMode) and dumps each candidate record to %LOCALAPPDATA%/Hd2ProjRecon/fmscan_records.txt. Writes nothing to game memory. Used to map the full-auto write (TertiaryFireMode +0x7C) and the cyclic-rate field.

Options.Name: FMScan
Options.Description: Read-only fire-mode value-scan. Run one mission, then check Hd2ProjRecon for fmscan_records.txt.
